descriptionChirho: Qal sense of physical trembling or quaking, whether of people shaking in fear or awe, or of the earth quaking.
Qal sense of emotional agitation, fury, or rage directed at someone or something.
Qal sense of engaging in a dispute or quarrel with others.
Hitpael reflexive-intensive sense of raging or being in a fury, expressing vehement agitation.
Hifil causative sense of making something or someone tremble or shake physically.
Hifil causative sense of disturbing, provoking to anger, or causing unrest to someone.
